settings.models.creditStrategy.explanati: When the active account hits its credit limit, switch to the next configured account on the same provider and keep using the same model.
Once credits are exhausted, fall back to the configured fallback LLM (with its own provider, model, and key) for the remainder of the conversation.
Pause execution until the provider's quota window resets, then resume on the same account. Use this when continuity matters more than throughput.
When credits run out, move CLI work to a new session on another provider using a compact handoff; same-provider recovery stays in the current session.

settings.decisionLayer.description: A fast, low-cost model on Vercel AI Gateway answers typed triage questions so the supervisor model is used less. It never approves permissions or takes destructive actions.

settings.decisionLayer.shadowByDefault: Enabled points only record their decisions next to the current behavior. A point acts only if you also allow it to, and only within its limits.
settings.decisionLayer.point.supervisor_: May postpone a wake-up by 2 minutes, only when the reason is idle time or a long text reply and the answer is confident. Never for questions, permissions, errors, stops or finished turns, and at most 3 times in a row.
settings.decisionLayer.point.worker_acti: May relabel a running command as a test run or not when confident. Display only.
settings.decisionLayer.point.supervisor_: Ask whether the supervisor needs to act after each worker check, and compare with what the observer did.
settings.decisionLayer.point.worker_acti: Ask whether a command a worker runs is a test run, and compare with the built-in pattern.
settings.decisionLayer.textLaneHelp: Short writing jobs a small, fast model can do instead of the supervisor model. If it fails or its answer is unusable, the current model is used.
